cmd: mcscan3 view browse --paf wga/col.ler.paf --paf wga/col.sha.paf --sv sv/col.ler.sv.tsv --pansv sv/pan.pansv.tsv  --identity view/ath.tsv --genome $AS/col.fa --title "Arabidopsis vs Col-0" -o view/ath.browser.html && ls -l view
caption: Interactive browser of alignments, SVs and identity along Col-0 (view/ath.browser.html).

name: contacts
summary: Hi-C contacts binned along the contigs (.npz), with the distance-decay exponent
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold contacts scaffold/in/contigs.fa --pairs scaffold/in/hic.pairs.gz -o scaffold/ler --resolution 10000
caption: Hi-C contacts binned along the contigs, with the distance-decay exponent.

name: hic
summary: Hi-C scaffolding, allele- and haplotype-aware: AGP, FASTA, groups, contact map
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold hic scaffold/in/contigs.fa --contacts scaffold/ler.contacts.npz -o scaffold/hic --groups 5 --resolution 10000 --break
caption: Hi-C scaffolding: misjoins broken, contigs grouped, ordered and oriented.
console: 2026-10-25 21:31:40 [INFO] mcscan3: 1176 unit links, 1176 kept after pruning allelic links
5 groups, 49 pieces placed, 0 unplaced, 3 misjoins cut

name: hicmap
summary: Hi-C contact map of scaffolds (whole genome or selected), log scale, scaffold outlines
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold hicmap scaffold/ler.contacts.npz scaffold/hic.agp -o scaffold/hicmap --format pdf
caption: Contact map of the scaffolds.

name: review
summary: Interactive review page: interactive contact map, curation, AGP/.assembly export
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold review scaffold/ler.contacts.npz scaffold/hic.agp -o scaffold/review.html && ls -l scaffold/review.html
caption: Interactive review page for manual curation (scaffold/review.html).

name: apply
summary: Build the scaffolds of an AGP or .assembly: AGP and FASTA
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold apply scaffold/in/contigs.fa scaffold/hic.agp -o scaffold/applied && grep -c '>' scaffold/applied.fa
caption: Scaffolds built from an AGP.

name: ref
summary: Reference-guided correction and scaffolding, several references at once
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold ref scaffold/in/contigs.fa --ref $AS/col.fa -o scaffold/ref --threads $CPU
caption: Reference-guided correction and scaffolding against Col-0.

name: map
summary: Genetic-map scaffolding: split, assign, order, orient
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold map scaffold/in/contigs.fa --map scaffold/in/map.tsv -o scaffold/map --format pdf
caption: Genetic-map scaffolding.

name: run
summary: Scaffolding with references, genetic maps and Hi-C in one graph; joins and conflicts reported
cmd: mcscan3 scaffold run scaffold/in/contigs.fa --ref $AS/col.fa --map scaffold/in/map.tsv --contacts scaffold/ler.contacts.npz -o scaffold/all  --threads $CPU
caption: References, the genetic map and Hi-C combined in one graph.

name: fix
summary: Check and repair a GFF3/GTF (IDs, parents, exons, UTRs, phases, spans, duplicates)
cmd: mcscan3 gff fix $E/Arabidopsis_thaliana.TAIR10.63.gff3.gz -o gff/tair10.fix.gff3
caption: IDs, parents, exons, UTRs and phases checked and repaired.

name: convert
summary: Convert between GFF3, GTF and BED
cmd: mcscan3 gff convert gff/tair10.fix.gff3 -o gff/tair10.gtf && mcscan3 gff convert gff/tair10.gtf -o gff/tair10.back.gff3  && mcscan3 gff convert gff/tair10.fix.gff3 -o gff/tair10.bed --name ID && head -2 gff/tair10.gtf
caption: GFF3 to GTF, back to GFF3, and to BED.

name: stats
summary: Numbers and lengths of genes, transcripts, exons, introns, CDS and UTRs
cmd: mkdir -p gff && mcscan3 gff stats $E/Arabidopsis_thaliana.TAIR10.63.gff3.gz --genome $IN/ath.dna.fa.gz -o gff/tair10.stats.tsv && cat gff/tair10.stats.tsv
caption: Numbers and lengths of genes, transcripts, exons, introns, CDS and UTRs.

name: longest
summary: Keep the longest isoform of each gene
cmd: mcscan3 gff longest gff/tair10.fix.gff3 -o gff/tair10.longest.gff3
caption: Longest isoform per gene.

name: filter
summary: Keep genes by type, location, attributes, length, protein size or exons
cmd: mcscan3 gff filter gff/tair10.fix.gff3 --coding -o gff/tair10.coding.gff3 && mcscan3 gff filter gff/tair10.fix.gff3 --noncoding  -o gff/tair10.noncoding.gff3 && mcscan3 gff filter gff/tair10.fix.gff3 --seqid Pt -o gff/tair10.pt.gff3
caption: Coding and non-coding genes split; plastid genes selected.

name: extract
summary: Sequences of genes, CDS, proteins, mRNAs, exons, introns, UTRs or flanks
cmd: mcscan3 gff extract gff/tair10.fix.gff3 $IN/ath.dna.fa.gz --type protein -o gff/tair10.pep.fa  && mcscan3 gff extract gff/tair10.pt.gff3 $IN/ath.dna.fa.gz --type protein --table 11 -o gff/tair10.pt.pep.fa && grep -c '>' gff/*.pep.fa
caption: Proteins translated from the genome (plastid genes with the bacterial code).

name: merge
summary: Merge annotations; overlapping genes join, identical transcripts are dropped
cmd: mcscan3 gff merge gff/tair10.coding.gff3 gff/tair10.noncoding.gff3 -o gff/tair10.merged.gff3  && mcscan3 gff compare gff/tair10.fix.gff3 gff/tair10.merged.gff3 -o gff/merged_vs_fix
caption: Coding and non-coding parts merged back and checked against the original.

name: rename
summary: Systematic IDs for genes, transcripts and their parts
cmd: mcscan3 gff rename gff/tair10.longest.gff3 --prefix ATH --template "{prefix}{chrom}G{n:05d}" --step 10 --per-seqid -o gff/tair10.renamed.gff3
caption: Systematic gene IDs, with the old-to-new table.

name: add
summary: Add introns, UTRs, intergenic regions or start/stop codons
cmd: mcscan3 gff add gff/tair10.fix.gff3 --introns --codons --intergenic --genome $IN/ath.dna.fa.gz -o gff/tair10.full.gff3
caption: Introns, start/stop codons and intergenic regions added.

name: compare
summary: Compare two annotations: loci and sensitivity/precision per level
cmd: mcscan3 gff compare gff/tair10.fix.gff3 gff/tair10.back.gff3 -o gff/roundtrip
caption: The GTF round trip compared with the original (sensitivity and precision at every level).

name: counts
summary: Gene x sample counts, TPM and CPM from featureCounts, htseq, Salmon, kallisto or RSEM
cmd: mkdir -p expr && mcscan3 expr counts $IN/yeast.counts.tsv --samples $IN/yeast.samples.tsv -o expr/yeast  && mcscan3 expr counts $IN/E-GEOD-43245-raw-counts.tsv.undecorated --samples $IN/brapa.samples.tsv --gff $E/Brassica_rapa.Brapa_1.0.63.gff3.gz  -o expr/brapa && mcscan3 expr counts $IN/E-MTAB-7978-raw-counts.tsv.undecorated --samples $IN/ath.samples.tsv --gff $E/Arabidopsis_thaliana.TAIR10.63.gff3.gz -o expr/ath
caption: Count, TPM and CPM tables: yeast WT/snf2 (42/44 replicates), B. rapa and A. thaliana tissues.

name: de
summary: Differential expression: genes ranked by Bayes factors, with replicate consistency checks
cmd: mcscan3 expr de expr/yeast.counts.tsv --contrast Snf2:WT --min-bf 2 --min-fc 1 --control 100 --subsets 50 -o expr/yeast.de
caption: Differential expression by Bayes factors with replicate checks (snf2 vs wild type).
